subject: Request: extended compliance credits & audit window for Parkside Health VPC PoC
messages:
From: Sasha Patel <sasha.p@clearbridgehealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T14:10:00-08:00
Subject: VPC PoC: request for extended credits and audit window

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — Parkside's security team wants to run a fully isolated VPC PoC but they flagged two blockers: the POC needs an extended evaluation window (we're asking 60 days) and additional credits to cover heavy egress and long-running job tests. They also want explicit, time-bound access to audit logs and an SOC2 excerpt showing log retention for the pilot.

I've attached our completed security questionnaire and a simplified network diagram for the target environment. Can Redwood provide:
- A 60-day extension on the isolated VPC POC?
- A $12k credit top-up scoped only to the Parkside account and tied to the VPC PoC?
- A short note on retention windows and where audit logs will be available during the pilot?

Procurement (procure@clearbridgehealth.com) will need the formal approval/contract amendment once you confirm the credit and extension.

Appreciate quick confirmation so we can move the SOW.

Best,
Sasha
Security & IT Lead
Parkside Health

Attachments: security_questionnaire_filled.pdf (pdf), network_diagram.png (image)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Patel <sasha.p@clearbridgehealth.com>, procure@clearbridgehealth.com
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: VPC PoC: request for extended credits and audit window

Hi Sasha —

Thanks for the detailed questionnaire and diagram. We're happy to support Parkside, and I want to outline the steps so procurement has what they need:

1) Credit & extension: I can provision a temporary credit pool and extend the VPC sandbox, but I need internal approval for the $12k top-up and 60-day window.
2) Audit logs & retention: We can provide a read-only log export (S3) and a short SOC2 excerpt that documents log retention policies for the platform; I'll attach the SOC2 snapshot once I have it cleared for sharing.
3) Contract amendment: we'll use a short DocuSign amendment to add the credit and adjust the POC end date.

I'm looping in Jonas (Ops) and Stephanie (Commercial) to confirm the credit allocation and sign-off path. Can you confirm the exact POC start and expected end dates (UTC)? Also helpful: the procurement contact's legal name and billing entity for the amendment.

Talk soon —
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: VPC PoC: request for extended credits and audit window

Kim / Steph —

Reviewed Parkside's questionnaire. Security asks look standard for an isolated POC. I approve a scoped credit top-up of $10k (not $12k) tied explicitly to the Parkside VPC PoC and a 45-day extension from their requested start date. Conditions:
- SOC2 snapshot must be attached to the amendment (SOC2-snapshot.pdf).
- Logs will be available as daily exports to an s3 bucket the customer controls; retention during the pilot is 90 days.
- Credits expire automatically at the end of the extension period and cannot be transferred.

If marketing/commercial wants to make an exception and cover the extra $2k for deal acceleration, sign off here and I will route to finance.

Jonas
Head of Infrastructure Operations
Redwood Inference

Good news: Ops has approved a $10,000 credit top-up and a 45-day extension for the Parkside VPC PoC. Conditions are listed below and we'll include them in the DocuSign amendment:

- Credit: $10,000 applied to the Parkside account (deal PKS-2026-031), valid only during the POC extension window.
- Extension: 45 days from your confirmed POC start date (please confirm start date in UTC).
- Audit logs: Daily exports to your S3 bucket; 90-day retention during POC. We'll provide the SOC2 excerpt (SOC2-snapshot.pdf) and a short runbook describing log access.
- Procurement: Please sign the attached DocuSign amendment to add the credit and new end date. Link: https://app.docusign.com/documents/ABC12345

If you confirm the start date and the billing entity name for the amendment I will get the DocuSign sent today. Also, Marissa will coordinate billing codes to ensure the credit is restricted to POC usage.

Thanks — excited to get Parkside onboarded in the isolated environment.

Regards,
